about: How strong each European club was in each earlier football season, on one scale across every country: league levels fitted to every UEFA cup game, plus each club's standing in its own league and its European form (scripts/lib/club-strength.mjs). An earlier season's Top 124 and Elite 32 are its strongest clubs that the season's sources give a squad (scripts/lib/europe-field.mjs). Each season, by the year it ends, lists its strongest clubs that played a top-division game that season: [the results' club, its map shape, strength in Elo points, and the shape of the league it played in where that is another country's]. Computed from David Schoch's football-data (Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0) by scripts/build-club-strength.mjs.
